bayome: Bayesian Occurrence-Abundance Microbiome Estimation

Source: R/bayome-package.R
bayome-package.Rd

Bayesian models for microbiome association studies, fitted with 'R-INLA'. The occurrence (presence/absence) and the abundance of each feature are modelled together: abundance effects are linked to occurrence effects and information is shared across features. Users write the same formulas as in maaslin3(); bayome translates them into INLA models. See bayome(), bm_prior(), bm_parse_formula() and bm_inla_formula(); results are plotted with the functions in bm_plot.

Details

bayome is an independent package, not part of 'MaAsLin3' or 'bioBakery'. Its interface, pre-processing, two-part structure, median comparison and output format follow 'MaAsLin3' (MIT license); the Bayesian models, the joint occurrence-abundance link, the information sharing across features and the selection rules are new.

References

Nickols WA, Kuntz T, Shen J, Maharjan S, Mallick H, Franzosa EA, Thompson KN, Nearing JT, Huttenhower C (2026). MaAsLin 3: refining and extending generalized multivariable linear models for meta-omic association discovery. Nature Methods, 23, 554-564. doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02923-9
